角.why: jué is the role/actor reading; the HSK 3 word (corner; jiao unit of money) is jiǎo

胖.why: typo/wrong tone: standard reading is pàng (pán is a rare literary reading)

地方.why: in the HSK sense 'place' the standard reading is dì fang (neutral); dì fāng is the 'local/regional (vs central)' sense
